title: Bounds on polynomial machine heads
statement: Let $d,C,q$ be natural numbers, let $s$ be either absent or a control stage (copy, setup, loop indexed by $i<d+1$, rewind indexed by $i<d+1$, advance indexed by $i<d+2$, or emit indexed by $j<C+1$), and let $h$ assign an integer head position to each $j<d+1$. If the positions satisfy the bounds prescribed by the stage—when $s$ is absent, $-1 \\le h(j) \\le q$; in a loop stage indexed by $i$, $0 \\le h(j) \\le q$ and $h(j)<q$ for $j \\ne i$; in a rewind stage indexed by $i$, $-1 \\le h(j)<q$ and $h(j)\\ge0$ for $j \\ne i$; or in an advance or emit stage, $0 \\le h(j)<q$—then every head position satisfies $-1 \\le h(j) \\le q$.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is absent or one of the listed control stages with its stated index range
$h$ assigns an integer to each index $j<d+1$
The head-position inequalities required by the chosen stage hold
